Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: stealth
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Getting in and out unseen. One loud pawn gives everyone away.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: search (ore)
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Finding and working the good seams.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: search (salvage)
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Knowing what is worth taking and getting it out of the wreckage.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: search (game)
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Tracking the herd and making the shots count.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: haul
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Carrying it all home. Shuttles and vehicles add their cargo room.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: endure
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Staying healthy on the road and patching each other up.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: farm
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Bringing in the crop before it spoils. Every pair of hands helps.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: build
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Putting walls and roofs back up. Every pair of hands helps.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: hack
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Getting old systems to open up. One expert is enough.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: teach
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Showing villagers how to hold a line. Everyone teaches, so a poor teacher drags the lesson down.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: tame
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Winning over wild animals. One good handler is enough.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: search (dig)
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Knowing where to dig, and digging carefully.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: contest (shooting)
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Hitting the targets in front of a crowd.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: contest (melee)
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Bouts in the ring, to first blood or a yield.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: contest (cooking)
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: One dish, a panel of hungry judges.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: contest (art)
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: A piece made on the spot and judged by the crowd.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: contest (crafting)
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Making something useful from a pile of scrap, against the clock.

Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.label: contest (debate)
Expeditions.ExpeditionChallengeDef.description: Winning the argument, and the room.
